info.title: Corridor Ramp API
info.description: Hosted multi-tenant on/off-ramp over Corridor's Stellar settlement hub. JSON in and out; amounts are integer strings in minor units; rates are decimal strings. Any POST may carry an Idempotency-Key. Ramp never holds end-user keys: it returns unsigned Stellar transactions for the user's wallet to sign.

Open a Tron deposit; returns the address to send USDT to
post.description: USDT on Tron becomes USDC on the user's Stellar account in two hops. The USDC in between lands at the Solana address of the user's own Stellar key and is burned with that key, so Ramp never holds it; Ramp pays the Solana fee. Answers 501 `not_configured` where the deployment has no Solana fee payer.

account.description: The user's Stellar account. The swap pays out to the same key on Solana.

amount.description: USDT to send, in Tron's 6 decimals. The solver network will not swap less than $100.

refundTo.description: The user's own Tron address, where an unfilled swap is refunded.
